5. After the adjustments, confirm that the clutch pedal free play 
(measured at the face of the pedal pad) and the distance 
between the clutch pedal (the face of the pedal pad) and the 
floorboard when the clutch is disengaged are within the 
standard value ranges.
Standard value (C): 6 − 13 mm (0.2 − 0.5 inch) 
Standard value (D): 76.4 mm (3.0 inches) or more 
6. If the measured free play and distance do not agree with the 
standard value ranges, it is probably the result of either air in 
the hydraulic system or a faulty master cylinder or clutch. 
Bleed the air, or disassemble and inspect the master 
cylinder or clutch.
7. Reinstall the carpet, etc.
